text:
mara: async standup — late shift (what I did / blockers / today)

samir: what I did: finished the regional allocator tweak for long-tail requests; ran a soak in us-east4 for 2h. no errors other than one spot eviction which recovered.
blockers: noticed colder KV cache hits in ap-southeast1 — 20% higher latency on small chat workloads.
today: will roll a targeted cache-friendly kernel to ap-southeast1 and monitor. ping me if you need warmup slots.

olivia: what I did: rotated a few nodes in eu-west1 to apply drivers + bumped the nodegroup max to 14. validated model variants are still routing.
blockers: quota request for extra g4dn slots is still in approvals (INF-4123).
today: following up with finance + sales to fast-track. if we get approval, I'll pre-allocate and enable autoscale policy.

cheng: what I did: added a telemetry flag to track prefix cache cold-starts per-lane. put alerts at 5% cold-start rate.
blockers: the alert is noisy in test; need to tune thresholds for low-traffic lanes.
today: tune alerting and add a short-lived metric to correlate node drains -> cold starts.

leah: what I did: ran the quota audit script for all regions; attached short CSV in the ticket. found a mismatch: ap-southeast1 has 18 reserved GPUs but the pool claims 22 (two leftovers from a failed deprovision).
blockers: need ops approval to force release the stale allocations.
today: filing a small runbook step to clean stale reservations and will coordinate a 5-min drain window.

mara: quick notes from me — what I did: triaged the late-night latency spike, identified a rollout that overrided batching params in us-east4. reverted rollout.
blockers: still seeing occasional P99 spikes ~2.1s on short sequences.
today: will enable continuous-batcher logging on a subset and open a tiny canary with reduced max_batch.

samir: small command if anyone wants to inspect the night lane pods quickly:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l lane=night -o wide
```

olivia: deploy-bot just reported a config job:
deploy-bot: nightly-prewarm completed for us-east4 (job id: 2026-5180). :white_check_mark:

mara: thanks — @leah can you block 5m at 02:30 UTC for the clean? i'll mute alerts during that.

leah: yep, blocking now. added note in INF-4123. :thumbsup:

cheng: FYI i'll add a short log field in the next PR so we can correlate request ids to warmup buckets. ping me for review.

samir: quick ask — if quota pulls through, I want 4 GPUs for 30m in ap-southeast1 to run the warmup sweep.

olivia: if finance approves, we can also use burst capacity for the warmup to avoid long commit.

mara: final — keep keeping async updates here. drop short pings when you start the warmup so I can mute the alerting window. thanks all.
